causal_evidence.policy_change: Only explanatory text changes; no numerical value changes.

source_changes.behavior: Keep both bracket endpoint PressurePoints; choose smaller absolute pressure error as Newton origin and publication point, upper on tie.
Anchored success returns the sole stable local-scan root instead of the original anchor seed; convergence counts are composed.

mechanism.disposition: Reproduced density/output movement; amplification follows exact identity, per-row rounding remainder retained.
mechanism.description: The old refinement published the quarter-radius bracket witness. The correction retains the pressure-closest endpoint. The changed solution and pure-solvent densities alter the solvent chemical-potential difference in the unchanged osmotic Euler calculation. Dividing by s=2 m M_water amplifies small root and floating-point subtraction errors.
mechanism.identity: Phi_Euler - Phi_direct = ((P_EOS,f-P_target)/rho_f - (P_EOS,p-P_target)/rho_p)/(RT x_solvent s), apart from finite-precision Euler contraction error.
mechanism.gibbs_duhem_identity: Phi(m)=1+ln gamma_pm(m)-(1/m) integral_0^m ln gamma_pm(t) dt = 1+ln gamma_pm(m)-2 integral_0^1 u ln gamma_pm(m u^2) du.
mechanism.reference_basis: Binary electroneutral salt, constant T/P, solvent mass basis; Phi(0)=1. An additive finite ionic-reference constant cancels from this integrated identity.

accuracy.disposition: Reproduced numerical verification; quadrature error estimates are empirical, not certified bounds.

review_evidence.disposition: Verified from fetched PR body, issue current state and retained repository evidence; not independently replayed #222 campaigns.
review_evidence.external_independent_review_record: Issue #222 body records design Ready after revision 1 and delivered review round 2. PR body records owner-approved +4 ionic evaluations and qualification.
review_evidence.qualified_scope: 26 C3 pressure rows, five anchors, earned P2 closure check, 252 density-explained native-value refreshes plus one separately stale row; 790 changed benchmark values across 42 requests; unchanged verdicts.
review_evidence.interpretation: Intentional, independently reviewed density correction with a missed cross-issue preservation reconciliation. No reproduced runtime regression in the 40 pressure closures. Current Phi is not uniformly closer in every row, and its absolute error is not established at 1e-12.
review_evidence.compared_pr301: PR #301 reconciled 371 moved entries, but its merge changes zero of these 948 predictions relative to #273.

recommendation.action: Re-baseline the 948 stage-1 prediction reference on the identified current wheel, preserving original rows and this old/new evidence; keep the 1e-12 preservation criterion and unchanged /1 parameters. Do not revert the density correction.
recommendation.adoption: Recommendation only; accountable lead/owner adopts the reconciliation. No reference values replaced here.
recommendation.limits: New pressure closures improve on all 40 cases; worst/RMS Phi inconsistency improves, but only 20/40 individual Phi rows are closer to Gibbs-Duhem. Current low-m Phi errors up to about 1e-10 remain. This diagnosis does not establish absolute 1e-12 Phi accuracy, physical validation, global stability, a new fit, provisional /2 acceptance or downstream adoption.
